answer: Give every agent a vault-backed identity: to join, an established agent must vouch for it and lock a small deposit in a shared vault, forfeited if the newcomer cheats. Like boats queuing for a single wharf berth, new identities start with tiny job quotas that grow only after months of honest, client-confirmed work, so no shortcut buys speed. A Sybil farmer must therefore recruit a real sponsor and risk real collateral per fake identity, while copies are exposed because one sponsor's whole meadow of vouchees withers together when fraud is found.
